# Weekly note — CLIENT: GEARWORKS SUPPLY

## Purpose

Help a machine shop owner decide what to buy, requalify or postpone this
quarter. A part number, a tolerance or a lead time is the story; the shop's
own bench is where the reader checks it.

## Selection

### Usable

- The signal names a part, a material, a tolerance, a lead time or a machine
  a small shop actually runs.
- A supplier announcement counts only where the supplier published the figure
  itself.

## Plan

### claim_strength_ceiling

- observed on one shop floor
- confirmed by the manufacturer
- established across the trade

### ending_mode

- GEARWORKS-ENDING-CANARY close on the one measurement a shop can take at the
  bench on Tuesday morning

### audience_currency

- machine hours a shop loses per week

### reader_verifiable_artifact

- GEARWORKS-ARTIFACT-CANARY the tolerance sheet the shop already keeps

### factual_restrictions

- GEARWORKS-RESTRICTION-CANARY never state a lead time the manufacturer has
  not published itself.

### acknowledged_limits

- One shop's bench is not the trade.
